meanings.en: to take a look, to glance

вообще-то.gloss: actually, as a matter of fact

examples.trans: My name is actually Yulia. Here's the sugar.

meanings.en: to date, go out with each other

meanings.en: after all, still, all the same

examples.text: Аркаш, мне москвичи звонят каждый день. Может, всё-таки передумаем?

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

imperative давай/давайте + 1st person plural or infinitive
